verdict.rationale: Marqeta provides tooling for card state transitions to block/suspend cards (docs-29,30), velocity and merchant-based authorization controls to limit spend patterns (docs-5,6,21,26,34), transaction retrieval and webhooks for real-time event monitoring (docs-7,9,20), and a Mastercard disputes API for compromised-card resolution (docs-8,22). However, there is no evidence of network fraud scores or Marqeta's own fraud-detection models surfaced at authorization time, nor explicit 'suspicious activity alert' tooling distinct from generic webhooks. missing for 10: fraud score/model surfaced at auth, dedicated suspicious-activity alerting, explicit reissue-card workflow.
